featured_reviews.name: Ashish Talekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been living in Sethia Imperial Avenue for almost 3 years now as an owner, and overall I can say the experience has been pleasant. The society is improving day by day. Initially, there were minor issues during the initial days, but ever since the resident committee took charge, the response time for any maintenance issue has drastically improved. Water supply is regular and clean, except during scheduled tank cleaning which happens quarterly — but even then, we get advance notice and alternative arrangements.

One thing I really appreciate is the use of STP (Sewage Treatment Plant) water strictly for toilet flushes. It saves fresh water and makes the society more eco-friendly without affecting hygiene or comfort. The security team is polite, and we have CCTV installed on every floor, giving a good sense of safety. My family feels secure, and my kids love the well-maintained play area. Festivals are celebrated together, giving a good community vibe. The location is a big plus, right next to the highway with easy metro access. Overall, a value-for-money project for end-users."

featured_reviews.review_text:

The flats are spacious, there’s enough sunlight, and zero seepage during rains — quite impressive compared to my previous rental experience. Yes, STP treated water is used for commodes , but inside the kitchen and bathroom, we have clean water.
